# Synthetic TAK fixtures

Generated by `tests/generate_fixtures.py` using the official TAKC 2.3.3 encoder.
The source waveforms are deterministic synthetic signals, created for this
project and distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later. No music samples are included.

Each `.s32le` file is the original signal converted to interleaved full-scale
signed 32-bit little-endian PCM. Generation also verifies that FFmpeg decodes
the corresponding `.tak` file to exactly these bytes. `manifest.json` records
the source parameters and compression preset for each case.

Normal Rust and CMake tests use these files directly, without Wine or FFmpeg.

The `legacy-*` fixtures use TAKC 1.0 from
https://www.rarewares.org/files/lossless/Tak1.0.zip and codec type 0.
`tests/generate_legacy_fixtures.py` generates them from the same synthetic
signals, enables the official encoder's verification, and checks the Rust
decoder against the source PCM, including seeks. `legacy-manifest.json`
records their parameters. No encoder executable is included.
